items.title: Secret protection must scale with software
items.summary: Today, one in three pull requests on GitHub involves an AI agent . A year ago, that number was fewer than one in 10. If that pace holds, within the next two years, most of the code pushed to GitHub could be written by an agent. Much of it may never be fully read by a human.
